name: Harbour dock at first night
fantasy: The player arrives at a working harbour after dark and has to find the one lit checkpoint among the cranes

layers.foreground: Coiled rope, a tipped crate, and the leaning edge of the dock framing the lower left
layers.midground: Lantern posts along the walkway with the checkpoint post lit brightest
layers.background: Crane silhouettes and moored hulls fading into harbour haze

focalPoint: The lit checkpoint lantern, highest local contrast, sitting on the third of the frame the path leads to
lighting: Low warm key from the lanterns, cold moon rim on the crane steel, deep shadow pockets under the dock edge
palette: design/aesthetic-profile.json — wet slate, bleached timber, lacquer red interactive accent
camera: Default third-person gameplay camera, 14 studs behind the avatar, 60 degree FOV
storyDetails: Paint worn off the lantern posts at hand height
Rope repair knot on the nearest bollard
Salt bloom creeping up the first stud of every post
A tarp half pulled over the crate someone left open
negativeSpace: The upper right sky stays quiet so the crane silhouettes read
motion: Slow lantern sway and water shimmer; nothing moves near the checkpoint so it reads as safe
